featuredProjects.title: SADEVZ Software Company
featuredProjects.description: A professional company website and client portal for SADEVZ, a software development studio based in Chitral. Built with a modern React and Next.js stack to showcase services, portfolio, and enable seamless client communication. Features an admin panel for managing projects, team members, and incoming inquiries, and an e-commerce-ready component library reused across client stores.
featuredProjects.challenge: Designing a digital presence that communicates technical credibility while remaining approachable for local businesses unfamiliar with software development. Performance on low-bandwidth connections in Chitral was a key consideration.

screenshots.caption: Homepage — hero section and services overview

featuredProjects.title: Native Resort & Camping Bamborate
featuredProjects.description: A complete hospitality platform for one of Chitral's premier eco-resorts. Built end-to-end: booking and e-commerce engine, real-time availability, admin dashboard for room and package management, gallery CMS, and a customer-facing experience that reflects the resort's natural setting. Every interaction was crafted to feel as serene as the destination itself.
featuredProjects.challenge: The client needed a system that non-technical staff could operate daily — managing bookings, updating rooms, uploading photos — without any developer involvement. Reliability in a low-bandwidth mountain region was a hard constraint.

screenshots.caption: Landing page — hero with live availability widget
Booking flow — date picker and confirmation

featuredProjects.title: Madina Home Textile — E-Commerce Store
featuredProjects.description: An e-commerce storefront for a home textile retailer selling curtains, foam, carpets and household items. Shoppers browse the catalog and check out directly on the site, while a purpose-built admin panel lets the owner manage products, track orders and read sales analytics without a spreadsheet. A lightweight built-in CMS handles banners, categories and promotional copy, so the shop updates itself without a developer.
featuredProjects.challenge: Delivering a fast, SEO-friendly online store on a small budget that a non-technical owner could run entirely alone — product management, orders, and storefront content — with checkout that works reliably for customers in Pakistan.

featuredProjects.title: Chitral Bazar — Marketplace Directory
featuredProjects.description: A directory and marketplace app for the whole Chitral Bazar: every registered shop is pinned on a custom-designed map of the bazar shown on the home screen, so users find a shop by location rather than scrolling a list. Shoppers follow favourite shops and leave reviews; e-commerce ordering is the next layer once the shop directory and map are complete.
featuredProjects.challenge: Modelling a real, messy physical bazar as data — hundreds of shops, categories and locations — on an interactive custom map that stays fast on mobile, while keeping the codebase ready to bolt on cart, checkout and payments.

featuredProjects.title: SaFit AI Diet Tracker
featuredProjects.description:
An AI-powered diet and nutrition tracking app built for health-conscious users. SaFit analyzes meals from natural text, tracks macros and calories, and provides personalized dietary recommendations powered by a language model. Designed with a clean, motivating UI to keep users engaged with their health goals. 
 This app is yet to be deployed, so would take a few more weeks.
featuredProjects.challenge: Accurately identifying food items and estimating nutritional values from natural language in real-world conditions. Building a recommendation engine that adapts to individual dietary needs and cultural food preferences was the core AI challenge.

screenshots.caption: Onboarding — goal setup and dietary preferences
Dashboard — daily macro and calorie overview
Meal logging — AI food recognition from photo

featuredProjects.title: Drosh Inn Hotel Platform
featuredProjects.description:
SADEVZ's first delivered product. A hotel management and booking platform for a hotel in the Drosh valley. Included a customer-facing booking site, WhatsApp integration for instant reservation confirmations, and a back-office panel with occupancy analytics and revenue tracking. 
 We are redesigning this website; therefore, it is not live anymore and would be deployed once completed and tested.
featuredProjects.challenge: Zero digital infrastructure to start. Built every layer from scratch — domain, hosting, database schema, email, WhatsApp webhook — and trained the owner's staff to use the admin panel independently within a week.

featuredProjects.title: Zubi VPN App
featuredProjects.description:
A production-grade VPN client for Android, built as a mobile developer in Chitral for an international networking company. The app handles protocol selection, server switching, kill-switch logic, and a clean onboarding flow, all wrapped in a technical UI that communicates security without intimidation. 
 The preview of this application is not available due to the concerns of the client.
featuredProjects.challenge: Integrating multiple VPN protocols within a single Android codebase while maintaining a smooth, consumer-friendly UX. Battery and connection-state management across Android versions was the hardest technical surface.

screenshots.caption: Home screen — server selection and connect button
